title: Do Ghariyon Ki Zindan Mein, Mehman Sakina Hai
body:
Sajjad Chalai Aao, Perishaan Sakina Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaisa Mei Kehrahee Hoon, Waisa Hee Tum Karogai
Kurthai Mairai Mei Bhaiya, Mujhko Dafan Karogai
Kuch Mangthee Hai Tumsai, Mehman Sakina Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Thora Sa Waqt Bhai, Moun Ronai Sai Nikalo
Thairee Muntazir Hai Behna, Aa Ker Issay Sambhalo
Kuch Dair Mei Daikhogai, Bai Jaan Sakina Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Mairai Goshwarai Bhaiya, Hain Shimr Nai Outharai
Balon Sai Mujh Ko Pakra, Moun Per Tamachai Marai
Samjha Na Thaharath Ka, Quran Sakina Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kantay Nikalnai Ka, Itna Mujhai Sila Do
Kuch Dair Kai Leeyai Hee, Baba Kai Sar Ko Laado
Phelai Baithee Apna, Damaan Sakina Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tauqeer Matami Kioun, Duniya Mei Dukh Othay
Ghairon Kai Dar Pai Jaa Kai, Kioun Jholiyan Phelau
Us Kay Mouamalon Ki, Nigraan Sakina Hai
